proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING PROXY ACCESS
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the board adopt a proxy access bylaw letting shareholders with 3% ownership held three years nominate director candidates included in company proxy materials.
proposals.evidence: our board unanimously recommends that you vote "AGAINST" this shareholder proposal

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING HUMAN RIGHTS REVIEW
proposals.proponent: The National Center for Public Policy Research
proposals.topic_summary: Requests management review human rights policies to identify needed additional policies and report findings by December 2016, omitting proprietary information.
proposals.evidence: THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS RECOMMENDS THAT THE SHAREHOLDERS VOTE AGAINST PROPOSAL NUMBER 6.
